search_text: published ZDI-20-676 ZDI-CAN-10095 Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-05-27 CVE-2020-8605 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-8605 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Trend Micro'] ['InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the LogSettingHandler class. title: Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the LogSettingHandler class. When parsing the mount_device parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
